I found no help via search but fortunately, I was able to fix the problem by turning off the setting Display rich link previews that was turned on by default after an update. It looks nice but will make this app unusable. At least for me.
author: atomrem

title: Please Update Widget
body: Right now Keep is among the few widgets that are still a translucent shade of black. Seems like the widget hasn't been fully optimized for the new iOS 10 lock screen yet. Looks tacky by comparison. Please fix this soon.
